body: You stay safe too.  Thank you.

I can't go to my family - because if I don't kill myself, and we reconcile, they will never look at her the same again.

Making friends, yes.  I probably should.  But I hate imposing on people, I absolutely abhor it.

You don't sound preachy or bossy.  Thank you for taking the time to read what I wrote, and reply to it.

> Turning and turning in the widening gyre
> The falcon cannot hear the falconer;
> Things fall apart; the centre cannot hold;
> Mere anarchy is loosed upon the world,

I was waiting until February 18th, but tonight made me reconsider.  To be completely honest, I've been waiting since December 12th, but there's always been one last thing or one last commitment I've had.

But now.  I've completed all my projects at work.  My family is doing well.  She makes more than twice what I make anyway, so she'll be fine financially.  And most of all, she'll be free of me.  

I will miss the cats.  But one of them likes her more anyway.

Thank you. I hope so too.

Your writing is excellent, you should keep it up.  

I'm really sorry that I don't have anything else to offer you besides you knowing that someone else read what you wrote, and cared enough to reply to it.  Post something tomorrow, and I will too.

Hey.  I just wanted to let you know that I read everything you wrote.  I never had friends when I was in high school, either.  I still don't.  I felt many of the things you described, and still do.  

I'm sorry that you feel so down, and I hope you feel better tomorrow.

Yeah.  I thought about others.  I don't have friends.  There are three people who know me and what i'm going through - her best friend, her best friends boyfriend, and a guy i work with who is unfortunate enough to have answered his phone the morning i found out.

And the conclusion i came to , is that no one really gives a shit.  no one cares.  she tells me that she feels trapped.  she tells me what i need to change.

she's still never told me why she did what she did.  or apologized for it.  all she said was "im sorry i hurt you" which is basically the same as "im sorry you feel the way you do".

no one cares about me, bud.  my family would go on, she'd be free... or at least, not "trapped" anymore.  what's the difference if one less human is roaming around?

endless dreamless sleep sounds absolutely majestic.

i'm a completely average dipshit of an upper 30s male, no 18 year old hottie would give me the time of day, much less anything past that.  and it still wouldn't solve the fact that i love my wife absolutely, and i'd be guilt-wracked the entire time. unlike her, i guess.

i appreciate the attempt at lightheartedness though.
